roms.name: Serial echo
roms.description: Echoes every byte received on 2SIO channel A. Identical to the core's built-in default ROM.

roms.name: Hello, world
roms.description: Prints a greeting to 2SIO channel A, then halts. Watch the register bar stop at HALT.

roms.name: Altair 8K ROM BASIC
roms.description: Mike Douglas's ROM build of Microsoft 8K BASIC 4.0 for the 88-2SIO (10h/11h). Entry at E000h relocates BASIC to 0000h and runs it - no sense switches. Not bundled: put the four 8kBas_*.bin files from deramp.com in web/roms/ (see roms/README.md).

roms.name: Lunar Lander
roms.description: Land the Apollo LEM by burning fuel one second at a time (Jim Storer, 1969; this is the Creative Computing 'ROCKET' version). Needs Altair 8K BASIC installed - it is typed in and RUN automatically.

roms.name: Hunt the Wumpus
roms.description: Stalk the Wumpus through a dodecahedron of caves; mind the bats and bottomless pits (Gregory Yob, 1973). Needs Altair 8K BASIC installed - it is typed in and RUN automatically.

roms.name: Super Star Trek
roms.description: Command the Enterprise across an 8x8 galaxy and hunt down the Klingon invasion fleet before time or energy runs out (Mayfield/Leedom; John Borders' 1978 Microsoft 8K port). Needs Altair 8K BASIC installed; ~460 lines, takes a few seconds to load.

roms.name: Hammurabi
roms.description: Rule ancient Sumeria for ten years: buy and sell land, feed your people, plant grain, and try not to starve them into revolt (Dyment/Ahl). Needs Altair 8K BASIC installed - it is typed in and RUN automatically.

roms.name: Hurkle
roms.description: A Hurkle is hiding on a 10x10 grid; you get compass-direction hints and five guesses to find it (Creative Computing). Needs Altair 8K BASIC installed - it is typed in and RUN automatically.
